english.note: This is the all-purpose Cantonese word for a written letter sent to someone.
Use 信 as the all-purpose noun for letters or written messages sent to someone.
Use this when the note is a short personal letter sent to someone.

examples.english: I mailed a letter to Grandma yesterday.
examples.traditional: 我尋日寄咗封信畀婆婆。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 cam4 jat6 gei3 zo2 fung1 seon3 bei2 po4 po4
ngo5 gam1 jat6 sau1 dou2 nei5 fung1 seon3

examples.english: I got a note from Mum yesterday.
examples.traditional: 我尋日收到阿媽寄畀我嘅信。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 cam4 jat6 sau1 dou3 aa3 maa1 gei3 bei2 ngo5 ge3 seon3
